description: Build and run iOS projects through Pitlane, keep the release backlog in Docket, and walk each release through the App Store steps.

interface.shortDescription: Build iOS apps and plan releases from Codex
interface.longDescription: Build, run and stop Xcode projects through Pitlane and read their errors. Pick the next task and record releases in Docket. Check a release against the eight release steps, plan a phased rollout and draft a featuring nomination. Pitlane and Docket run on your Mac.
